note_evidence: The heavy distorted bass clearly ducks and swells back up on every kick drum hit right from 0:00, creating a very obvious and rhythmic pumping effect.
beat_evidence: A strong syncopated funk beat and heavy kick drum establish a clear and tappable pulse immediately at 0:00.
loop_evidence: While the energy is steady for most of the track, the instruments drop out abruptly at 0:38 leaving a reverb tail and silence that would ruin a seamless loop.
